verdict.rationale: The IRS is a government tax-filing and payments service, not an AI agent or host application that could consume tools from MCP servers. Acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any agent or assistant surface that could act as an MCP client; the documented machine channels (MeF XML transmission, IRIS A2A) are credentialed intake rails, not tool-consuming agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
